arxiv-1405-6181.title: py-oopsi: the python implementation of the fast-oopsi algorithm
arxiv-1405-6181.creator: Benyuan Liu
arxiv-1405-6181.description: Abstract Fast-oopsi was developed by joshua vogelstein in 2009, which is now widely used to extract neuron spike activities from calcium fluorescence signals. Here, we propose detailed implementation of the fast-oopsi algorithm in python programming language. Some corrections are also made to the original fast-oopsi paper.

arxiv-2202-02648.title: Transitions in Entanglement Complexity in Random Circuits
arxiv-2202-02648.creator: Sarah True, Alioscia Hamma
arxiv-2202-02648.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sarah True, Alioscia Hamma. Entanglement is the defining characteristic of quantum mechanics. Bipartite entanglement is characterized by the von Neumann entropy. Entanglement is not just described by a number, however; it is also characterized by its level of complexity. The complexity of entanglement is at the root of the onset of quantum chaos, universal distribution of entanglement spectrum statistics, hardness of a disentangling algorithm and of the quantum machine learning of an unknown random circuit, and universal temporal entanglement fluctuations.

arxiv-2203-07163.title: Strong enhancement of electromagnetic shower development induced by high-energy photons in a thick oriented tungsten crystal
arxiv-2203-07163.creator: M. Soldani, L. Bandiera, M. Moulson, G. Ballerini, V.G. Baryshevsky, L. Bomben, C. Brizzolari, N. Charitonidis, G.L. D’Alessandro, D. De Salvador, M. van Dijk, G. arxiv-2203-07163.description: Abstract We have observed a significant enhancement in the energy deposition by 25 25 – 100 ​ GeV 100~\mathrm{GeV} photons in a 1 ​ cm 1~\mathrm{cm} thick tungsten crystal oriented along its ⟨ 111 ⟩ \langle 111\rangle lattice axes. At 100 ​ GeV 100~\mathrm{GeV} , this enhancement, with respect to the value observed without axial alignment, is more than twofold.

arxiv-2307-09429.title: Lattice Reduced and Complete Convex Bodies
arxiv-2307-09429.creator: Giulia Codenotti and Ansgar Freyer
arxiv-2307-09429.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Giulia Codenotti and Ansgar Freyer. The purpose of this paper is to study convex bodies C C for which there exists no convex body C ′ ⊊ C C^{\prime}\subsetneq C of the same lattice width. Such bodies shall be called “lattice reduced”, and they occur naturally in the study of the flatness constant in integer programming, as well as other problems related to lattice width.

arxiv-2406-09979.title: HIRO: Hierarchical Information Retrieval Optimization
arxiv-2406-09979.creator: Krish Goel, Mahek Chandak
arxiv-2406-09979.description: Abstract . Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has revolutionized natural language processing by dynamically integrating external knowledge into Large Language Models (LLMs), addressing their limitation of static training datasets. Recent implementations of RAG leverage hierarchical data structures, which organize documents at various levels of summarization and information density.

arxiv-2410-07972.title: Learning Equivariant Non-Local Electron Density Functionals
arxiv-2410-07972.creator: Nicholas Gao, Eike Eberhard, Stephan Günnemann
arxiv-2410-07972.description: Abstract The accuracy of density functional theory hinges on the approximation of non-local contributions to the exchange-correlation (XC) functional. To date, machine-learned and human-designed approximations suffer from insufficient accuracy, limited scalability, or dependence on costly reference data. To address these issues, we introduce Equivariant Graph Exchange Correlation (EG-XC), a novel non-local XC functional based on equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs).

arxiv-2501-00105.title: A configuration space model for algebraic function spaces To Benson Farb on his 57 th birthday
arxiv-2501-00105.creator: Oishee Banerjee
arxiv-2501-00105.description: Abstract We prove that the space of algebraic maps between two smooth projective varieties, under certain conditions, admit a configuration space model, thereby obtaining an algebro-geometric analogue of Bendersky-Gitler’s result ( [ BG91 , Theorem 7.1] ) on topological function spaces.

arxiv-2501-17130.title: Entanglement-based Quantum Key Distribution in the Daylight and Uplink Satellite Configuration: Proof-of-Principal Demonstration and Feasibility Test
arxiv-2501-17130.creator: Kaushik Joarder 1,2, Jakub Szlachetka 1,2, Piotr Kolenderski 1
arxiv-2501-17130.description: Abstract Experimental realization of entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD) in a daylight uplink (ground-to-satellite) communication channel is highly challenging due to the very low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of this configuration and it has yet to be successfully implemented to date.

arxiv-2505-00202.title: On graphs without four-vertex induced subgraphs
arxiv-2505-00202.creator: Kathie Cameron 1, Chính T. Hoàng 2, Taite LaGrange 3
arxiv-2505-00202.description: Abstract Given a family F F of graphs, a graph G G is F F -free if it does not contain any graph in F F as an induced subgraph. The problem of determining the complexity of colouring ( c ​ l ​ a ​ w claw , 4 ​ K 1 4K_{1} )-free graphs is a well-known open problem.

arxiv-2507-15035.creator: Zhijun Zeng, Youjia Zheng, Hao Hu, Zeyuan Dong, Yihang Zheng, Xinliang Liu, Jinzhuo Wang, Zuoqiang Shi, Linfeng Zhang, Yubing Li, He Sun
arxiv-2507-15035.description: Abstract Accurate and efficient simulation of wave equations is crucial in computational wave imaging applications, such as ultrasound computed tomography (USCT), which reconstructs tissue material properties from observed scattered waves. Traditional numerical solvers for wave equations are computationally intensive and often unstable, limiting their practical applications for quasi-real-time image reconstruction.

pmc-10637224.title: The Role of Duration of Chlorhexidine Gluconate 2% Application on the Shear Bond Strength of a Total Etch Bonding Agent: A Comparative Study

pmc-10637224.description: IntroductionMatrix metalloproteinases enzymes (MMPs) can degrade the hybrid layer which can cause failure of composite restorations. Chlorhexidine gluconate 2% can reduce MMPs activity and increase the bond strength of the resin to dentin.PurposeThis study aims to determine the role of the duration of chlorhexidine gluconate 2% application on shear bond strength of a total-etch bonding agent.

pmc-11405792.description: This study aimed to differentiate the flavor characteristics of raw chicken breast meat from Thai slow-growing breeds (NC: native chicken, and KC: Korat/crossbred chicken) and fast-growing broilers (BR: broiler chicken) by using NMR-based metabolomic approaches along with multivariate data analysis.

pmc-11443664.title: Evaluating the halogen bonding strength of a iodoloisoxazolium(III) salt
pmc-11443664.creator: Dominik L Reinhard, Anna Schmidt, Marc Sons, Julian Wolf, Elric Engelage, Stefan M Huber
pmc-11443664.description: Diaryliodonium(III) salts have been established as powerful halogen-bond donors in recent years. Herein, a new structural motif for this compound class was developed: iodoloisoxazolium salts, bearing a cyclic five-membered iodolium core fused with an isoxazole ring. A derivative of this class was synthesized and investigated in the solid state by X-ray crystallography.

pmc-11492961.title: Exploring the decision-making experience of elderly diabetes patients regarding their health-seeking behaviour: a descriptive qualitative study
pmc-11492961.creator: Qiu Hui Du, Jin Hong Yang, Zi Chen Zhang, Shao Bo Li, Yu Qin Liu, Yu Min Li, You Yang, Hong Hong Jia
pmc-11492961.description: AbstractBackgroundDiabetes has emerged as a critical global public health issue. The burden of diabetes is escalating in developing countries, including China. For individuals with diabetes, making informed and rational decisions regarding health-seeking behaviour is crucial to prevent or delay the occurrence of complications.

pmc-11615346.title: Association between first-trimester subchorionic hematoma and pregnancy loss before 20 weeks of gestation in singleton pregnancies
pmc-11615346.creator: Ying Lou, Guili Chen, Lanying Wang, Xiaoqing Zhao, Jianting Ma
pmc-11615346.description: To evaluate the association between a first-trimester subchorionic hematoma (SCH) and pregnancy loss before 20 weeks of gestation in singleton pregnancies. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of singleton pregnancies from January to December 2021. All patients had routine first-trimester ultrasound scans and were followed up for pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-12662574.title: Bridging the digital divide: Enhancing doctor-patient communication through digital media platforms
pmc-12662574.creator: Andi S. Amir, Deddy Mulyana, Susanne Dida, Jenny R. Suminar
pmc-12662574.description: BACKGROUND:Leveraging digital media platforms can enhance communication between healthcare providers and patients, ensuring timely, accurate, and personalized medical information, especially amid the global shift toward telemedicine. This research addresses the inadequate communication between doctors and patients, particularly in areas with limited digital literacy and access, exacerbating healthcare disparities in underserved communities.

pmc-12692348.title: Interplay Between DNA Polymerase, RNA Polymerase, and RNase H1 During Head-On Transcription–Replication Conflict
pmc-12692348.creator: Nadezhda A Timofeyeva, Ekaterina I Tsoi, Darya S Novopashina, Nikita A Kuznetsov, Aleksandra A Kuznetsova, Luis Felipe Jiménez-García
pmc-12692348.description: Transcription–replication conflicts (TRCs) often occur in cells and cause DNA replication fork stalling. In this study, we investigated the interplay of RNA polymerase (RNAP), DNA polymerase, and RNase H1 (RH1) during head-on TRC in vitro with precise control over the reaction conditions.

pmc-13059760.title: Analysis and engineering of quorum sensing-based communications between bacteria and fungi
pmc-13059760.creator: Yongsheng Zhou, Lingjin Tang, Danlei Chen, Yanni Li, Shengbo Wu, Jianjun Qiao
pmc-13059760.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Bacteria and fungi ubiquitously coexist, with their interactions critically influencing human health and industrial processes. Quorum sensing (QS) is a core regulatory mechanism that enables density-dependent coordination and phenotypic responses across these two kingdoms. While bacteria and fungi utilize their respective QS systems to engage in competitive or cooperative interactions to enhance their environmental adaptability, the current understanding of QS-based communications between them remains scattered, and a systematic summary of this field is still lacking.

pmc-13355509.title: Real-time sensing-integrated organoid-on-a-chip platforms: Technological progress and emerging biomedical applications
pmc-13355509.creator: Chenwei Sun, Guohua Wu, Di Wu, Qijun Du, Qingrui Lu, Wenqi Hu, Jiashu Wang, Ao Xie, Zipeng Yao, Mengjiao Xia, Haijie Hu, Shuqi Wang
pmc-13355509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As micro-scale 3D tissues self-organized from stem cells, organoids can highly recapitulate the cellular composition and complex spatial architecture of human organs, establishing themselves as pivotal physiological models in biomedical research. Although organoids offer significant advantages in mimicking human physiological structures, traditional monitoring methodologies predominantly rely on destructive endpoint assays, which fail to capture the transient fluctuations inherent in biological processes. To overcome this limitation, we propose the sensing-integrated organoid-on-a-chip, a frontier interdisciplinary platform.
